issue.title: Reliable notification snoozing and resurfacing
issue.description: Snoozed notifications use one durable time contract, resurface as visible unread activity at the requested deadline, and are delivered and ordered consistently across ACE, CLI, mobile gateway, and Telegram consumers.

issue.title: Canonical snooze state and expiry contract
issue.description: core-expiry: make the Rust notification store own validated deadlines, atomic active-row expiry, resurface metadata, and next-deadline projection.

issue.title: Deadline-driven ACE reminders
issue.description: ace-deadlines: add a pump-free nearest-deadline coordinator that remains reliable across refresh settings, restarts, suspend, clock changes, and notification mutations.

issue.title: Cross-surface resurface ordering and delivery
issue.description: downstream-resurface: adopt current-state reads and resurface activity cursors in CLI, mobile gateway, and Telegram projections so old snoozed rows become new visible activity.

issue.title: End-to-end regression matrix and documentation
issue.description: regression-docs: verify state, timing, ordering, concurrency, and downstream delivery together and document the resulting guarantees and recovery behavior.
